ch04.s01.title: Three Statements on Building the Site
ch04.s01.summary: January 2024. The old odw goes up. Gotō and Brother Ji built it together.
beats: January 2024. The old odw went up. Gotō and Brother Ji built it together.

Gotō wanted to do harm reduction. When he first came to the plateau, information was sealed off, the guides incomplete and in pieces, and he'd already been through hell without knowing how to fight back. He was one of them.
odw actually became a harm-reduction site, and a place for my imagination — not a place for od.

ch04.s02.title: The Libertarians and the Harm-Reduction Camp
ch04.s02.summary: Brother Ji is a libertarian; Gotō wants harm reduction. Developing freedom and developing harm reduction are like mortal enemies.
beats: But Brother Ji was a libertarian. The old editorial team had every faction under the sun, held together almost entirely by Gotō dragging them in.
Landmines were buried in the foundation itself — infighting and splits.
Brother Ji wanted to post unhinged things and flirt with jirai girls from the official account; Gotō wouldn't allow it. Gotō wanted harm reduction.
The conservative control faction proposed od non-proliferation: seal the whole circle off, keep it safe from the iron fist, let it digest itself internally.
Developing freedom and developing harm reduction are like mortal enemies.

ch04.s03.title: Emergency Notice
ch04.s03.summary: An "emergency" announcement: the accounts and the site go back to Brother Ji. The circle splits in two.
beats: June 29, 2024. An "emergency" announcement: admin S.G gives up the site permissions; the accounts and the site return to Brother Ji's control.
You win... the place is yours now.
The direct cause: Gotō wouldn't let Brother Ji use the official account to post unhinged things and flirt; Brother Ji's nuclear deterrent was wanting the account back.
The circle split in two: Brother Ji had the account, Gotō had the domain. The old editorial team regrouped around Gotō's account.
Gotō's odw is the harm-reduction camp, Ji's odw the libertarians. Both groups went quiet for a few seconds. Then the brawl started — a scene with neither logic nor reason.

ch04.s04.title: Fake Gotō
ch04.s04.summary: The 'Fake Gotō' incident. The name itself became a weapon, and the material for the struggle sessions piled up.
beats: July 19 to 21, the 'Fake Gotō' incident. Gotō warned that the Ji-controlled od-wiki was disguising itself.
The language is stiff, the words carry something dark, and it will come looking for you.
The name itself became a weapon. The material for the struggle sessions piled up: the donepezil incident, whether odw is useful, who owns odw.
Gotō wanted to talk to Brother Ji properly.
When I talked to him properly, he either went straight to nuclear weapons or played dumb and flashed anti-counterfeit marks. No way to communicate.
In the end he went straight to nuclear weapons.

ch04.s05.title: Nuclear Weapons
ch04.s05.summary: 'Nuclear weapons' means doxxing — holding someone's private information and threatening to publish it.
beats: 'Nuclear weapons' means doxxing — holding the other person's private information and threatening to make it public.
August 29 to 31, Gotō broke down.
Harm reduction, my ass... if I'm not getting grabbed by Brother Ji, I'm getting forced by you lot... fine, pure schizophrenia on the plateau, I'll play along, you motherfuckers.
September 3, the third year of high school started. He left a doggerel poem behind and walked away. Left the circle.

ch04.s06.title: Leaving the Circle
ch04.s06.summary: September 3, the third year of high school begins. He leaves a doggerel poem behind and goes.
beats: September 21. The Cooling Report reached out to Gotō, who had already left the circle, to get the basics of od. Gotō's role there amounted to having his name attached.

ch04.s07.title: The Christmas Struggle Session
ch04.s07.summary: December 25, the video drops. The struggle session climbs from private morals to harm reduction itself.
beats: December 25, the video went up.
We reached an oder named 'Gotō' who has already left the circle, and learned...
The struggle session began. A conservative psychotic, driven mad by pregabalin, fanned the flames and spread the rumor that Gotō had gone to the media himself.
Brother Ji and another person came to add fuel, throwing in 'Gotō wants to precision-strike the od circle.'
That touched the interests of every person on the plateau. The struggle session climbed from personal and private morals, to the ideology of developing harm reduction, to harm reduction itself.

ch04.s08.title: After the Struggle Session
ch04.s08.summary: Brother Ji releases the nuclear weapon he had held for half a year — the doxx. Gotō enters the burial ground.
beats: Brother Ji released the nuclear weapon he'd been holding for half a year — the doxx.
Gotō and his harm reduction went into the plateau's burial ground together.

Gotō only learned the video was out once the struggle session had started, and only learned of the trouble near the end. He went back and told the Cooling Report that all he could do was revise the video.
I'm quite avoidant. I told myself that if I left the circle completely, none of this had anything to do with me, and I didn't want to go back and explain.

ch04.s09.title: Anti-Harm-Reduction
ch04.s09.summary: Anti-harm-reduction, designer drugs, victim narratives, and a kind of defeatism.
beats: What followed: anti-harm-reduction, designer drugs, victim narratives, and a kind of defeatism.
Harm reduction is betraying od, spreading od, hurting more oders. Only continuing to od is the right path.

ch04.s10.title: Rashomon Opens
ch04.s10.summary: Gotō says: our common enemy is the defeatists and reactionaries on the plateau.
beats: There are a lot of people on the plateau waving the banner of justice while running reactionary corruption — selfish, their heads full of themselves — and they've left many oders who wanted out with nowhere to go.
The reactionaries say my method is so wrong, but they themselves can't produce a method to help anyone, and have never had any results.
Our common enemy is these defeatists and reactionaries on the plateau!
Ugh, old Gotō, why don't you come back. The people quitting o need you.
When I first joined the old odw project, it was to make harm reduction easier for me. Unfortunately Brother Ji wasn't a normal partner, and it ended like this.
Here the Rashomon opens in full.

ch04.s11.title: Voice One · Anti-Gotō
ch04.s11.summary: He had already broken down and attempted suicide when he split with his ex, and mentioned blowing up od along the way.
beats: He had already broken down and attempted suicide when he split with his ex-girlfriend, and mentioned blowing up od along the way. Not long after, he was recruiting people in the odwiki group for an interview — thinking about it now, that was this video.

ch04.s12.title: Voice Two · Gotō
ch04.s12.summary: "My role there was just having my name attached."
beats: If not for those two hounding me, maybe I wouldn't have been slandered and dragged through the mud like this.
That so-called interview doesn't compare to the pile of interviews I heard about afterwards. My role there was just having my name attached.
Add that I'd left the circle and couldn't fight back, plus Brother Ji's doxx helping, and I was made into an idiot who spreads od in the name of harm reduction.

ch04.s13.title: Voice Three · Muyu
ch04.s13.summary: "I have no money, I'm short on money, so what if I took money?"
beats: Yes, I did the interview. So what? I have no money, I'm short on money — so what if I took money?

My goal is to destroy the od circle and build a real drug circle, so everyone generally understands something about drug abuse and new psychoactive substances, for the greatest possible self-protection.

ch04.s14.title: Forty-Six Minutes
ch04.s14.summary: Forty-six minutes and forty-eight seconds. '5555' is Muyu, and the spearhead points at odw's Xiao Wu.
beats: Three voices, three accounts.

June 26, 2025, a video went up. Forty-six minutes and forty-eight seconds. The person who agreed to a follow-up interview with their face shown calls themselves '5555' — in reality, Muyu. The spearhead points at odw's Xiao Wu.
Xiao Wu, who had left the circle, was instantly cursed into oblivion; his DMs were flooded.
Xiao Wu needed to fight back, but he only wanted his quiet life. So he had Gotō take over the account and handle the exchange.

ch04.s15.title: Caretaking the Account
ch04.s15.summary: Gotō takes over Xiao Wu's account. September 3, the counterattack begins.
beats: Gotō had his own reasons: he wanted his posthumous name to be less shameful — he'd been struggled against to death for merely having his name in a video, while Muyu showed his face, made noise, and got to bounce around selling designer drugs.
August 31 to September 6, Gotō ran Xiao Wu's account. September 3, the counterattack began: Gotō wrote a mass of evidence of Muyu's and Brother Ji's crimes under odw's official account.

ch04.s16.title: The Counterattack Begins
ch04.s16.summary: Almost every oder official post was written by Gotō — just under odw's name.
beats: In fact almost every oder official post was written by Gotō, only under odw's name.
September 21, the main force that toppled Gotō — a certain critic — went to war with Xiao Wu and Gotō.

ch04.s17.title: The Critic Goes to War
ch04.s17.summary: "Xiao Wu is reviving Gotō, so double-team Xiao Wu."
beats: Xiao Wu is reviving Gotō, so we double-team Xiao Wu.
The critic gathered a crowd, attacked together, and secretly wrecked Xiao Wu's life.
By the critic's own thinking, Muyu deserved to be struggled down more; in the end the critic only went after Gotō — and later the critic became a new Muyu himself.

ch04.s18.title: Fake Exit
ch04.s18.summary: Muyu uses a fake exit to escape. Xiao Wu's life is nearly destroyed.
beats: September 24, Muyu chose a fake exit to escape. Xiao Wu thought it was over, but it seemed too late.
Xiao Wu's life was nearly completely destroyed. He kept blaming Gotō for being late.

ch04.s19.title: Fake Death
ch04.s19.summary: Muyu returns from a fake death. The Wu–Mu war stops; Xiao Wu's life is already a mess.
beats: Then October 21, Muyu returned from a fake death; November 25, more barking from Muyu. The Wu–Mu war more or less stopped, but Xiao Wu's life was already a mess.
In the end none of them managed to keep a quiet, peaceful life.

ch04.s20.title: Publishing the Document
ch04.s20.summary: December 7, 2025. Gotō publishes the document, signed Super Goto-Goto-Gotō.
beats: Gotō later made this document public, signed Super Goto-Goto-Gotō, December 7, 2025.
I know publishing this file is worthless now... but this was Xiao Wu's obsession. He wanted to prove something, so I published it.
But the meaning doesn't seem to matter anymore.

ch04.s21.title: FreeODwiki
ch04.s21.summary: Another group couldn't stand Gotō or Brother Ji, so they built their own FreeODwiki.
beats: While the Gotō–Ji war was raging, another group — who couldn't stand Gotō and couldn't stand Brother Ji either — built their own FreeODwiki.
They didn't like Gotō, but they hated Brother Ji more. The one leading it was Sage. That chronicle of od history was written by Sage and the FreeODwiki people.

ch04.s22.title: Edward
ch04.s22.summary: Edward was on that side too; later he took 1161 and died. Gotō had cursed him out.
beats: Edward was on that side too. Later he took 1161 and died; Zhenyin was his caregiver. Gotō had cursed him out.
Back then Edward doxxed himself and put it out. That I did curse him out — that's true.
You only see me cursing him, and then fallaciously conclude there was some persecution.

ch04.s23.title: The Policy Dispute
ch04.s23.summary: November 21, 2025. Sage attacks odw's original policy.
beats: November 21, 2025. Sage attacks odw's original policy. odw states "it must make the reader feel taboo and disgust."
So the whole policy of odw was wrong, useless to oders. Then why bother making a wiki at all? Just copy the official line and repeat "cherish life, stay away from drugs."

ch04.s24.title: The Magnesium Entry
ch04.s24.summary: "odw's article perspective isn't just subjective — it's strongly moralized."
beats: Why doesn't the magnesium entry fit? odw's article perspective isn't just subjective, it's strongly moralized.

ch04.s25.title: Gotō Responds
ch04.s25.summary: "Oders' safety and future are not the sacrificial offering of your absurd ideas."
beats: Oders' safety and future are not the sacrificial offering of your absurd ideas.

ch04.s26.title: Sage Rebuts
ch04.s26.summary: "I rather suspect other oders' safety and future are the sacrifice of your ideas."
beats: I rather suspect other oders' safety and future are the sacrifice of your ideas.
For example, n55 recently, and the others who o'd into the ICU — how responsible do you think your odw is for the harm done to them?

ch04.s27.title: Epistemology
ch04.s27.summary: April 20, 2026. The real difficulty lies in two-sided knowledge.
beats: April 20, 2026. Sage talks about the epistemology of harm reduction.
"Antidepressants like sertraline cannot be used for od" is common knowledge in the drug circle — a typical example of knowledge doing harm reduction.
But not all knowledge does harm reduction. The classic case is "salt can be used to unalive."
The real OD non-proliferation difficulty doesn't lie in black-and-white knowledge. It lies in two-sided knowledge — knowledge that can be used for harm reduction and can also get people hurt.

ch04.s28.title: The Paid Interview
ch04.s28.summary: November 2026. Muyu gives another interview before dying. The video is paywalled.
beats: November 2026, before he died, Muyu gave another interview to a video creator, exposing and distorting the drug circle again. The video required payment to watch.
The creator treated the drug circle's business as a joke, teasing it out, shaking out more and darker things. The drug circle's story was twisted into a freak show for outsiders to watch for traffic.

ch04.s29.title: Nanyuan
ch04.s29.summary: November 18, 2026. The ledger on scheduling dextromethorphan goes from three-to-seven to one-to-nine.
beats: November 18, 2026.
One rainy night last summer, Guigui, Misako and I argued about whether scheduling dextromethorphan was more good than harm, how it splits. Back then I thought it was three to seven.

Now look: outside the wall, 1161 sour-milk-grape everywhere, kill cases beyond counting; inside the wall, the young and restless are running on compound paracetamol-amantadine and iodine, and the ICU says it can't take it.
I've always left people a way out, so now I think the ledger on scheduling dextromethorphan is one to nine.

ch04.s30.title: The Scheduling Countdown
ch04.s30.summary: As dextromethorphan, guaifenesin tablets and pregabalin are scheduled, the drug circle enters a countdown.
beats: As dextromethorphan, guaifenesin-dextromethorphan tablets and pregabalin were scheduled, the drug circle entered a countdown.

The harm-reduction people had nothing left to o: a small number did successfully escape the plateau; most suffered from mental disorders and conventional psychiatric drugs, some even killed themselves or switched factions.

ch04.s31.title: The Price of Freedom
ch04.s31.summary: Those who went libertarian died from not respecting designer drugs. The blind camp started taking anything.
beats: Some switched to the libertarian camp and died from not respecting designer drugs — opioid and benzodiazepine respiratory depression killed people everywhere.
The blind camp, finding common abused drugs unavailable, started taking anything: sertraline, cold medicine, even ibuprofen and iodine — drugs with no psychoactive effect at all.

ch04.s32.title: A Letter
ch04.s32.summary: "Teacher, will the guaifenesin tablets be controlled too?"
beats: Teacher, will the guaifenesin tablets be controlled too? Life after dropping out is still so bad. I'm scared that one day when I need it again, I'll find it's been scheduled.
Absolutely. At least you still have grain. Going out and walking around is always interesting. Of course, it depends on whether there's scenery.

ch04.s33.title: Parents Cut Off the Pills
ch04.s33.summary: "Stop o-ing. Use metoprolol to hold it down. Look at the sea."
beats: If I don't od, my parents will probably cut off my meds. Teacher, how can I od safely and happily through these four weeks?
Stop o-ing. Use metoprolol to hold it down, and to hold the addiction down too. Look at the sea. But still take it as the doctor ordered.

ch04.s34.title: The Drug Circle Spat On
ch04.s34.summary: The drug circle became a place everyone spat on.
beats: The drug circle became a place everyone spat on.
Do you know about that dextromethorphan?
You mean that drug? I really don't know what those people are thinking.

ch04.s35.title: Patient
ch04.s35.summary: "If not for dextromethorphan and pregabalin, I'd have jumped long ago."
beats: The Five Golden Flowers did nothing for me. They're used all over psychiatry only because they don't make you feel good — that's all. The so-called antidepressant effect is bullshit!
If not for dextromethorphan and pregabalin, I'd have jumped long ago! They're what made me a sound person!
The state scheduling those drugs is just blindly chasing social stability. But what about us? Who exactly is going to solve this society's damn mental illness?

ch04.s36.title: Comment
ch04.s36.summary: "Aren't you mentally ill people just weak in the head?" The comment gets a mass of likes.
beats: Aren't you mentally ill people just weak in the head? Better to die early and stop wasting the country's resources.
This comment got a mass of likes.
Just a bunch of druggie bugs chasing pleasure.
Neck's eating vinegar lol~

ch04.s37.title: The Drug Circle Falls Apart
ch04.s37.summary: The most-surveilled street is empty. The paid freak show is still updating.
beats: o non-proliferation became a sheet of waste paper. The most-surveilled street is empty. The paid freak show is still updating. The drug circle fell apart, while the people outside the wall only recognize the word "drug."
Gotō is still answering questions. The DMs are still ringing.

ch04.s38.title: Gotō Is Still Answering
ch04.s38.summary: "Don't." "Look at the sea." "At least you still have grain."
beats: Don't.
Look at the sea.
At least you still have grain.

beats: What is the way out for oders?
